name: Dense Depth Estimation via Plane Sweep
aliases: Live Image Capturing and Dense Depth Estimation (Woetzel and Koch)
definition: A live system for image capturing and dense depth estimation where the plane-sweep algorithm runs almost entirely on the GPU.
summary: Dense Depth Estimation via Plane Sweep estimates per-pixel depth by projecting depth planes into multiple views to evaluate photometric consistency, combining rendering and reconstruction without producing an explicit intermediate volume.
